reason: Production Release Readback received HTTP 503 from /api/connectors/readiness and therefore correctly blocked promotion.
rootCause: The public readiness endpoint was not structurally isolated from the authenticated /api/connectors/* wildcard, creating a route-collision failure mode. In parallel, Netlify production could lag the current releasable main SHA, so merged code alone was insufficient proof of production state.
failedApproach: Treating a successful merge, a ready Netlify deploy, or the connector-readiness source code in isolation as proof that production was healthy.
fix: Exclude /api/connectors/readiness from the authenticated wildcard; preserve the exact public readiness route; require exact production release identity; use bounded transient-5xx retries and fail closed; complete production readback before declaring live.

learning.futureBehavior: Every matching 5xx production-readback failure must be fingerprinted, persisted as learning evidence, routed through canonical universal learning, checked against this prevention rule, and kept red until exact production readback is green.
